definitions.explanation: A metal container used for preserving food and drinks.

notes:
{缶|かん} refers to metal cans, commonly used for beverages and preserved food.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{缶詰|かんづめ}→缶詰：00187_kanzume⟧: canned food
- ⟦{空|あ}き→空き：10464_aki⟧{缶|かん}: empty can
- {缶|かん}⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧: canned beer
- {缶|かん}⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧: canned coffee
- ⟦{缶切|かんき}り→缶切り：07011_kankiri⟧: can opener

CULTURAL NOTE:
Canned drinks ({缶|かん}⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧, {缶|かん}⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧) are very popular and sold in vending machines everywhere. Cans are recycled separately from other garbage - look for {缶|かん} bins.

ALTERNATIVE KANJI:
Also written as {罐|かん} (less common).
